steps.text: If everyone cared only for their own town's history, we'd have a pretty boring world.

options.text: Do you really think you did the right thing?

steps.player: Do you really think you did the right thing?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I had no other choice. I couldn't just stand by!

options.text: Did you know Varlamore sends thieves to the Colosseum?

steps.player: Did you know Varlamore sends thieves to the Colosseum?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: But I'm no thief! Give me a chance to explain...

options.text: What if I came into your house and stole your stuff?

steps.player: What if I came into your house and stole your stuff?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Then you'd be a thief! This is nothing like that!

options.text: You've committed a crime.

steps.player: You've committed a crime.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I have not! Just give me a chance to explain!

options.text: How will Varlamorians learn their history now?

steps.player: How will Varlamorians learn their history now?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well, they can always come visit. Or perhaps we can arrange a loan?

options.text: Varlamore might never let you and your colleagues visit again!

steps.player: Varlamore might never let you and your colleagues visit again!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I've done Varlamore a great service! They just don't know it yet...

options.text: You should return all these artefacts. It's the only right thing to do.

steps.player: You should return all these artefacts. It's the only right thing to do.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'll return them as soon as I know they'll be safe. Until then, they'll stay right here!

options.text: You're a disgrace to your entire profession!

steps.player: You're a disgrace to your entire profession!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: How dare you! I've never once failed to follow the proper procedures. Well, except this one time. But this is different!

options.text: Varlamore might close their lands again after this.

steps.player: Varlamore might close their lands again after this.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Better that than the loss of a priceless artefact! It's not my fault they didn't look after it.

options.text: How do you explain the other stolen artefacts you have in storage?

steps.player: How do you explain the other stolen artefacts you have in storage?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I didn't steal them! The museum simply borrowed them for further study.

options.text: You could have damaged the artefact!

steps.player: You could have damaged the artefact!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Had I not done something, it could well have been damaged anyway!

options.text: Why don't you just cooperate with Varlamore?

steps.player: Why don't you just cooperate with Varlamore?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Believe me, I've been trying!

options.text: Why should you decide who gets to keep their artefacts?

steps.player: Why should you get to decide who gets to keep their artefacts?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Because I'm the only one willing to protect them!

options.text: You're setting a terrible example.

steps.player: You're setting a terrible example.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Oh dear... Children! Pay no attention to this loud, dramatic argument!

options.text: Is everything here stolen from other museums?

steps.player: Is everything here stolen from other museums?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Nothing here is stolen from other museums! Er... I mean, nothing is stolen at all!

options.text: You can't justify theft by saying it's for preservation.

steps.player: You can't justify theft by saying it's for preservation.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well that's the reality. Sometimes you have to make tough choices.

options.text: I'm sick of your excuses!

steps.player: I'm sick of your excuses!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'm sick of your shouting!

options.text: You're not above the law! You stole this stuff!

steps.player: You're not above the law! You stole this stuff!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: It's more complicated than that!

options.text: What makes you think you know better?

steps.player: What makes you think you know better?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: The fact that I had to save this artefact at all says enough. It needs to be kept safe!

options.text: What if it's cursed?! It could be dangerous!

steps.player: What if it's cursed?! It could be dangerous!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Are you quite serious? Just because an artefact is from another culture doesn't mean it's cursed. Adventurers these days...

options.text: Stealing is stealing, no matter how you try to justify it.

steps.player: Stealing is stealing, no matter how you try to justify it.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Normally I'd agree, but this one situation is a little more nuanced than that...

options.text: Is the artefact really safer here?

steps.player: Is the artefact really safer here?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Absolutely! We're the greatest, most well-equipped museum in the world!

options.text: Look me in the eye and tell me you did the right thing.

steps.player: Look me in the eye and tell me you did the right thing.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I... I did the right... Stop staring at me like that!

options.text: You're hoarding artefacts, but you should be sharing them!

steps.player: You're hoarding artefacts, but you should be sharing them!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: We don't have enough room to show everything in our collections. If only we had the funding...

options.text: You're a loose cannon.

steps.player: You're a loose cannon.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: A loose cannon? A wild card maybe. Or a lone ranger. But a loose cannon?! Surely not...

options.text: Hand that artefact back this instant!

steps.player: Hand that artefact back this instant!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: There's no need to take that tone with me!

options.text: I guess you were just in it for the glory, were you?

steps.player: I guess you were just in it for the glory, were you?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: That's not true! I mean, I am better than this. I mean... oh, I'm all mixed up.

options.text: This is stealing! Thieving! Taking what's not yours!

steps.player: This is stealing! Thieving! Taking what's not yours!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Please stop telling everyone I'm a thief...

options.text: You've stolen from several other museums, too!

steps.player: You've stolen from several other museums, too!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Not every museum has the resources to keep their artefacts safe. We're just taking care of them for now.

options.text: This artefact doesn't belong to you! It belongs to Varlamore!

steps.player: This artefact doesn't belong to you! It belongs to Varlamore!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I believe artefacts like this belong to all of us. That's why it's so important for me to preserve them.

options.text: Have you no respect for your colleagues in Varlamore?

steps.player: Have you no respect for your colleagues in Varlamore?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: They had the choice to take better care with this artefact! That's not on me.

options.text: Aren't you embarrassed to have stolen items in your collection?

steps.player: Aren't you embarrassed to have stolen items in your collection?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'm not embarrassed! I just put it in storage for... for normal reasons!

options.text: You're nothing but a common thief!

steps.player: You're nothing but a common thief!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: How dare you? I'm a well-renowned professional, not a thief!

options.text: Stealing is against the law!

steps.player: Stealing is against the law!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well, sometimes the law is wrong!

options.text: You ought to be ashamed.

steps.player: You ought to be ashamed.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: For what? I'm only doing my job!

options.text: This could destroy your reputation! Everyone will think you're a thief!

steps.player: This could destroy your reputation! Everyone will think you're a thief!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Oh, nonsense! Any real historian would see I'm only trying to preserve vital historical knowledge.

options.text: You've betrayed the trust of Varlamore.

steps.player: You've betrayed the trust of Varlamore.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: It's not my fault they couldn't look after their own history. Better that I took it than some thief!

options.text: Are you even a real historian, or just a petty criminal?

steps.player: Are you even a real historian, or just a petty criminal?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Of course I'm a real historian! This just isn't my finest moment...

options.text: You don't even have room to display it! It's just sitting in storage!

steps.player: You don't even have room to display it! It's just sitting in storage!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Artefacts aren't just for gawking at! We keep things in storage so they can be studied and taken care of.

options.text: You're not preserving anything. You're just a thief.

steps.player: You're not preserving anything. You're just a thief.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Pish-posh! I haven't dedicated my life to this museum for you to slander my good name!

options.text: Think of the Varlamorian children who won't get to see this artefact.

steps.player: Think of the Varlamorian children who won't get to see this artefact.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Now that's not true! They can see it any time they visit Varrock, for free!

steps.player: You can't just keep claiming these stolen goods as your own!

steps.text: If the player fails the interrogation:

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Oh, pish posh! I've had enough of this little shame game of yours! I've got better things to be doing with my time. Come back to me when you've got your facts straight!
If the player is successful with the interrogation:

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I didn't steal anything! These are ethically acquired antiquities!

steps.player: What do you mean? How did you come into possession of Xerna's Diadem? I've heard all about your travels back here with it.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Well...
Cutscene goes to the Grand Museum.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Naturally, as soon as Varlamore opened, I was keen to visit their Grand Museum.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: There was a big event over at the Colosseum, so it was nice and quiet. Perfect for taking in everything the museum had to offer.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: All of a sudden, I heard a strange noise coming from behind me...
Camera pans across the museum as Haig Halen walks and confronts a thief.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: It was a thief! He'd stolen Xerna's Diadem!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I had to act quick. I called upon my skills from my time in the Varrock Guard and I showed him what for!
Haig Halen defeats the thief, with the thief falling on the floor.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: He went down easily, but I was left with a conundrum: What to do with the diadem.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: This was a priceless artefact, and it was at risk! I knew it had to be protected, and there was nowhere better than in Varrock...
Cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Now I don't know what to do...

steps.player: You can't just be taking these things as your own!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I promise, I only wanted to keep it safe. I guess I panicked...

steps.player: I'll do you a deal. If you arrange for the safe delivery of the diadem back to the Grand Museum, I'll let them know it's taken care of without mentioning your name.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Okay... I'll have it sent back at once.

steps.player: Thank you. I'll head over there and let them know.

options.text: Have you any interesting news?
Do you know where I could find any treasure?
How do I get a medallion?

in-varrock-museum-talking-to-curator-hai.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
in-varrock-museum-talking-to-curator-hai.text: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.

options.text: Talk about Fossil Island.
About Xerna's Diadem...

steps.player: About Xerna's Diadem...

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I'm just making arrangements to have it sent back to Fortis. It will be there very soon.

steps.player: Thank you. I'll head over there and let them know.

options.text: Have you any interesting news?
Do you know where I could find any treasure?
How do I get a medallion?

in-varrock-museum-talking-to-curator-her.speaker: Curator Herminius
in-varrock-museum-talking-to-curator-her.text: Nilsal to you, iknami. Welcome back to the Grand Museum. If you have any questions, I'm happy to help.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the early history of Varlamore?
Could you tell me more about religion in Varlamore?
Could you tell me more about Varlamore's recent history?
About that empty display...

steps.player: About that empty display...

steps.speaker: Curator Herminius
steps.text: How are you getting on with your investigation?

steps.player: Well, it turned out to be quite the saga, but I found it! Xerna's Diadem is on its way back here, as we speak.

steps.speaker: Curator Herminius
steps.text: It is? That's great news! Where did you find it?

steps.player: It was a little far away... But we'll save that story for another day.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Curator Herminius
steps.text: Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned?

steps.player: Oh yes, I better make some space for it.

steps.speaker: Curator Herminius
steps.text: Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned? Here you go.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

options.text: Thanks. If I have any questions, I'll be sure to ask.
